description: Free, read-only. Fetch an RSS 2.0 or Atom feed and return JSON: feed title, link, description, lastBuildDate, itemCount, truncated, and items[] with title, link, pubDate, guid, description (HTML stripped), author, categories, enclosure. Items past maxItems are dropped and truncated=true. A URL that is not a feed returns type 'unknown' and no items. Not JSON Feed. Errors on non-2xx, 10 s timeout or private hosts.

maxItems.description: Default 20, max 200. itemCount still reports the full total.

url.description: Feed URL, http(s). Private hosts refused.

name: rss_parse
title: Parse RSS or Atom feed
